preview.readOnly: Browser preview is read-only. Configure models in the macOS app.
preview.mcpReadOnly: Browser preview only; configure MCP in the macOS app.

status.partialModelReadFailed: Some model statuses could not be read. Recording and basic search are still available.

capability.voiceLocalDescription: Chinese, English, and more · about 1.02 GB
capability.voiceModelPlaceholder: For example, whisper-1 or a provider model ID
capability.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved; leave empty to keep it
capability.emptyKeyPlaceholder: Can be empty for a local service
capability.localPrivacy: Content is processed on this Mac and is not sent to a model service.
capability.embeddingPrivacy: Creating the index sends current memory text; later additions, edits, and search questions (including related memories and MCP searches) are sent. The vector index stays on this Mac.
capability.voicePrivacy: Audio is sent in segments to the selected service while recording. You can edit the transcript; it is saved only after you submit.
capability.llmPrivacy: Questions, necessary conversation, and related memories are sent when used. Automatic organization also sends new records and relevant context.
capability.autoOrganizeDescription: Records saved while this is off keep their original text and are not organized when you turn it back on.
capability.fastResponse: Faster responses (turn off reasoning; model support required)

embedding.failedMemories_one: {{count}} memory could not be processed. You can still find it by keyword.
embedding.failedMemories_other: {{count}} memories could not be processed. You can still find them by keyword.
embedding.confirmCurrent: This will process the current memories. You can still record, read, and use basic search while preparation runs.
embedding.confirmCount_one: This will process {{count}} current memory. You can still record, read, and use basic search while preparation runs.
embedding.confirmCount_other: This will process {{count}} current memories. You can still record, read, and use basic search while preparation runs.
embedding.localConfirm: Everything is processed on this Mac. Archived items, history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
embedding.remoteConfirm: Text excerpts will be sent to “{{service}}”; later additions and edits are processed incrementally and may incur provider charges. Archived items, history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
embedding.rebuildCurrent: The current memories will be processed again with the active model. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Basic search remains available and the text stays unchanged.
embedding.rebuildCount_one: The active model will process {{count}} current memory again. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Basic search remains available and the text stays unchanged.
embedding.rebuildCount_other: The active model will process {{count}} current memories again. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Basic search remains available and the text stays unchanged.

voice.preloadDescription: When off, the model loads when you start recording. Memory is freed after one minute of inactivity.
voice.shortcutDescription: Press once to open the quick entry and record; press again to stop.

desktop.title: macOS quick entry
desktop.shortcutDescription: The global shortcut opens or collapses Quick Entry, even after closing the main window. ⌘Q quits Memivy.
desktop.foregroundPrivacy: The foreground app name is read when you open Quick Entry. Links and file paths are only attached by you.

login.title: Start at login
login.notFoundHelp: Move Memivy to the Applications folder and try again.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Backups include memories, original captures, versions, discussions, drafts, and trash; model keys are excluded.
backup.restoreDescription: Restore the entire library and automatically keep a copy from before the restore.
backup.verifiedSummary: Backup verified. It contains {{memories}} memories and {{captures}} original captures. After you confirm, the library will restart and restore everything; current content is first saved as a recoverable copy.
backup.settingsRetained: Model configuration and the MCP switch keep their current settings.

storage.title: Manage local model files
storage.description: Delete downloaded models to free up space. Your memories are kept; you can download the models again when needed.
storage.deleteDialogDescription: This will free about {{size}} MB. You will need to download this model again to use it.
storage.localModelDisabled: Features using this model will be turned off.
storage.serviceUnaffected: Features using an online model are not affected.
storage.contentRetained: Memories, original captures, and drafts are kept.

mcp.title: External Agent · MCP
mcp.description: Allow an external Agent to save original text you explicitly ask it to remember and search a small set of saved memories. The Agent may send returned content to the model it uses. Search shares the semantic-search setting; after you select a model service, search questions are also sent to that service.
mcp.enabledNotice: Enabled. Add a Memivy connection in your other AI app.
mcp.disabledNotice: Disabled. Other AI apps can no longer save or search memories through MCP.
mcp.executableMissing: The external connection component is missing. Reinstall Memivy.
mcp.connectionInstructions: Move Memivy to a fixed installation location before copying the configuration. Your external Agent must support local stdio; add the service as instructed and reconnect. Copy the configuration again after moving the app.
mcp.afterExit: Memivy can still save and search after it exits; automatic organization continues the next time the app opens with a model available. Turn off this switch to stop new MCP reads and writes.
mcp.diagnosticPassed_one: MCP check passed. {{count}} function is available.
mcp.diagnosticPassed_other: MCP check passed. {{count}} functions are available.
mcp.diagnosticScope: The local connection works. This does not confirm that an external Agent is connected.
mcp.diagnosticEnabled: Read and write access is currently allowed.
mcp.diagnosticDisabled: Access is turned off. Saving and searching memories are unavailable.
mcp.tryConnection: After connecting, try “Remember: this is my MCP test note”, then search for that sentence. Only a successful call confirms that the external Agent is connected.

searchMaintenance.title: Search maintenance
searchMaintenance.rebuildDescription: Try this if search results are missing or inaccurate.
searchMaintenance.dialogDescription: Search data will be rebuilt. Your memories and drafts will not be changed.
